main_measure.name: t of mean of x = (-forecast/10) * -(r2 - coin mean 2-bar return), Sunday short cases
main_measure.threshold: confirm t >= 2 with check < 0; reject t <= -2; at least 100 cases

supporting_check.name: mean(r2 - m) top third minus bottom third by |forecast|

decided_by: t >= 2 but the supporting check is at or above 0, which the plan rules inconclusive.
reading: Sunday bar = bar whose UTC start is a Sunday (next bar Monday); 'rose' read as raw 1-bar return > 0; cases need t+2 inside the window; thirds by |forecast| from a stable ascending sort split with np.array_split; fewer than 100 cases reported as not observable per the minimum-count rule.
